description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {2}.
Pitiless Plunderer and Blood Artist trigger.
Resolve Pitiless Plunderer's ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve Blood Artist's ability, causing target opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.
